newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain bans Netherlands pigs due to swine fever.
newsitem.headline: Spain bans Netherlands pigs due to swine fever.

text.p: Spain has banned pig imports from the Netherlands due to an outbreak of swine fever, the Agriculture Ministry said on Thursday.
The ministry said the disease was not dangerous to human beings, and it had imposed the ban as a preventative measure to protect the domestic livestock.
With Dutch farmers undercutting market prices, Spain is worried that sick pigs may be offloaded onto the Spanish market.
"Offers from Dutch producers at prices well below the market is something that could significantly increase the risk (to our livestock)," the ministry said in a statement.
The ministry also criticised insufficient European regulations to guarantee the health of Europe's pig trade.
Spain imported some 37,000 tonnes of pig livestock from the Netherlands in 1995.
